DELETE FROM estate.cases WHERE subject_person_id = 'lisa' AND flags ? 'cron_text_test';
seed_sql: WITH c AS (INSERT INTO estate.cases (case_type, subject_person_id, event_date, knowledge_date, bundesland, flags) VALUES ('incapacity', 'lisa', CURRENT_DATE - 5, CURRENT_DATE - 5, 'berlin', '{"cron_text_test": true}'::jsonb) RETURNING id) INSERT INTO estate.case_tasks (case_id, phase, title, due_date, hardness) SELECT c.id, v.phase, v.title, v.due, v.hard FROM c, (VALUES ('immediate', 'CRONTEXT A1', CURRENT_DATE - 1, 'critical'), ('first_week', 'CRONTEXT B1', CURRENT_DATE + 2, 'recommended')) AS v(phase, title, due, hard);
